nodes.name: Lemma 5
nodes.statement:
Consider fixed indices $\pi^{\natural}(i)$ and $j$ such that $j\neq \pi^{\natural}(i)$.
Assuming that $(i)$ $\textup{srank}(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural})\gg \log^4 n$,
$(ii)$ $n\gtrsim p \log^6 n$, $(iii)$
intersection of events
${\cal F}_1(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural})\bigcap { {\cal F}_1\big(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural} \widetilde{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}}_{\setminus (\pi^{\natural}(i), j)}^{\top} \big) }\bigcap {\cal F}_6 \bigcap {\cal F}_7 \bigcap {\cal F}_8$ holds, and $(iv)$ $\mathsf{SNR} \geq c$,
 we have $\{\mathsf{Term}_{\textup{tot}} \geq \Delta_{(\textup{multi, 1})}\}$
hold with probability
$1 - n^{-c}$ when $n$ and $p$ are sufficiently large.
Here $\mathsf{Term}_{\textup{tot}}$ and $\Delta_{(\textup{multi, 1})}$ are defined in
(22) and Section~B.1, respectively.

nodes.name: Lemma 6
nodes.statement:
Conditional on the intersection of events ${\cal F}_1(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural})\bigcap {\cal F}_5$ and fixing the indices $\pi^{\natural}(i)$ and $j$ $(j\neq \pi^{\natural}(i))$,
we have
\[
\mathsf{Term}_{1} \lesssim \sigma(\log n)^{\nicefrac{5}{2}}\sqrt{\frac{p}{n}}\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}.
\]
hold with probability at least $1-n^{-c}$, where $\mathsf{Term}_1$ is defined in
(23).

nodes.name: Lemma 7
nodes.statement:
Conditional on the intersection of events
${\cal F}_6 \bigcap {\cal F}_7$ and fixing the indices
$\pi^{\natural}(i)$ and $j$ $(j \neq \pi^{\natural}(i))$, we know
$\mathsf{Term}_{2} \lesssim \sigma (\log^2 n) \ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}$ hold
with probability at least $1 - n^{-c}$, where
$\mathsf{Term}_2$ is defined in (24).

nodes.name: Lemma 8
nodes.statement:
Conditional on event ${\cal F}_2\bigcap {\cal F}_5$ and fixing the
indices $\pi^{\natural}(i)$ and $j$, we have
$\mathsf{Term}_{3} \lesssim  \frac{mp(\log^2 n)\sigma^2}{n}
+ (\log^2 n)\sigma^2\sqrt{\frac{mp}{n}}$ hold
with probability exceeding $1 - c_0 n^{-c_1}$,
where $\mathsf{Term}_3$ is defined in (25), and
$c_0, c_1 > 0$ are some fixed positive constants.

nodes.name: Lemma 9
nodes.statement:
Consider the sensing matrix $\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}$ with its entries
$\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, j}$ being sub-gaussian RV with zero mean and unit variance $(1\leq i \leq n, 1\leq j \leq p)$.
Assume that $(i)$ $n\gg p \log^3 n\cdot \log^2(n^2 p^3)$,
$(ii)$ $\textup{srank}(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}) \gg \log n$, $(iii)$ $h\leq c\cdot  n$,
$(iv)$ conditional on ${\cal F}_8$,
and $(v)$ $\log \mathsf{SNR} \gtrsim \log \log n$,
we conclude
\[
\mathbb{P}\left(\big\|\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural \top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{\pi^{\natural}(i), :} - \widehat{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}}^{\top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{j, :} \big\|_{2}^2
-  \big\|(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural} - \widehat{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}})^{\top} \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{\pi^{\natural}(i), : } \big\|_{2}^2
\gtrsim \Delta_{(\textup{multi, 2})}\right) \geq 1 - c_0 n^{-c_1},
\]
where $\Delta_{(\textup{multi, 2})} = \Delta_2 + \Delta_3$, which are defined in
(19) and (20), respectively.

nodes.name: Lemma 10
nodes.statement:
Conditioning on ${\cal F}_2$,
we have
\[
\mathbb{P}\left({\left\|\ensuremath{\mathbf{W}}^{\top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}} \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, :} \right\|}_{2} \leq \
c (n\log n)\sqrt{m \sigma^2},~\exists~1\leq i \leq n \right) \geq
1 - c_0 n^{-c_1}.
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 11
nodes.statement:
Consider the sensing matrix $\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}$ with its entries
$\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, j}$ being log-concave sub-gaussian RV with zero mean and unit variance
$(1\leq i \leq n, 1\leq j \leq p)$.
Assume that $(i)$ $n\gg p^{1 + \varepsilon} \log^{3(1 +\varepsilon)} n\cdot \log^{2(1+\varepsilon)}(n^2 p^3)$,
$(ii)$ $\textup{srank}(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}) \geq c(\varepsilon)$,
$(iii)$ $h\leq c\cdot n$, $(iv)$ conditional on ${\cal F}_8$,
and
\begin{align}

\textup(v)~~\log \mathsf{SNR} \gtrsim \frac{\log n}{\textup{srank}(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural})} + \log \log n,
\end{align}
we conclude
\[
\mathbb{P}\left(\big\|\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural \top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{\pi^{\natural}(i), :} - \widehat{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}}^{\top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{j, :} \big\|_{2}^2
-  \big\|(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural} - \widehat{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}})^{\top} \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{\pi^{\natural}(i), : } \big\|_{2}^2
\gtrsim \Delta_{(\textup{multi, 2})}\right) \geq 1 - c_0 n^{-c_1},
\]
where $\varepsilon > 0$ is an arbitrary positive constant;
$c(\varepsilon)$ is some positive constant depending only on $\varepsilon$;
and $\Delta_{(\textup{multi, 2})} = \Delta_2 + \Delta_3$, whose definitions can be found in
(19) and (20), respectively.

nodes.name: Lemma 12, Lemma 13, Lemma 14, Lemma 15, Lemma 16, Lemma 17, Lemma 18, Lemma 19
nodes.statement:
For an arbitrary row $\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, :}$, we have
\[
{\left\|\ensuremath{\mathbf{M}}^{\top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, :}\right\|}_{2} \lesssim \sqrt{\log n} \ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural},
\]
with probability exceeding $1 - n^{-c}$.

For an arbitrary row $\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, :}$ (or $\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, :}^{'}$), we have
\[
\langle \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, :}, \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{j, :}^{'}\rangle  ~&\lesssim (\log n)\sqrt{p} , ~~1\leq i, j \leq n; \\
\langle \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{i, :}, \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{j, :}\rangle ~&\lesssim  (\log n)\sqrt{p},~~1\leq i\neq j \leq n; \\
\langle \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}^{'}_{i, :}, \ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}^{'}_{j, :}\rangle ~&\lesssim  (\log n)\sqrt{p},~~1\leq i\neq j \leq n,
\]
hold with probability $1-n^{-c}$.

We conclude $\mathbb{P}\left({\cal F}_4\right) \geq 1-n e^{-cnp}$.

Conditional on the intersection of
events ${\cal F}_3 \bigcap {\cal F}_4$, we have
$\mathbb{P}\left({\cal F}_5\right)\geq 1 - n^{-c}$.

Conditional on ${\cal F}_4$,
we have $\mathbb{P}({\cal F}_6) \geq 1- c p^{-2}$.

Conditional on the intersection of
events ${\cal F}_1(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}) \bigcap {\cal F}_2$, we conclude
\[
\big \|\big(\widetilde{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}} - \widetilde{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}}_{\setminus (s)}\big)^{\top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{s, :}\big \|_{2}
\lesssim \frac{p\log^{\nicefrac{3}{2}} n}{n} \ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}.
\]

Conditional on the intersection of events
${\cal F}_1(\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}) \bigcap {\cal F}_2$, we conclude
\[
{\left\|(\widetilde{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}} - \widetilde{\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}}_{\setminus (s, t)})^{\top}\ensuremath{\mathbf{X}}_{s, :} \right\|}_{2}
\lesssim \frac{p\log^{\nicefrac{3}{2}} n}{n}\ensuremath{\mathbf{B}}^{\natural}.
\]

Conditional on the intersection of
events ${\cal F}_6\bigcap {\cal F}_7$, we
conclude $\mathbb{P}({\cal F}_8) \geq 1-c_0 \cdot n^{-c_1}$.
